name: @lmntlz/api
//: The server half. It may import @lmntlz/sim/resolver and /ai; apps/client may not, and eslint.config.js enforces that on the client rather than here.

scripts.//dev: src/dev.ts explains why this is not `vercel dev` — the Hono preset's Development Command is `pnpm dev`, so `vercel dev` recursively invokes itself and refuses to start.
scripts.//db: ONE canonical env location: .env.local at the repo root, beside .env.example. A second --env-file-if-exists pointing here printed 'not found' on every run for a file we deliberately do not have, and tsx echoed it once per process it spawns — three lines of noise claiming the env had not loaded when it had. A warning that is always wrong is worse than no warning.
scripts.//db:seed-bots: The twenty starter bots. seedStarterBots() shipped with feature 009 and its only callers were tests, which delete the bots again — so the function was perfect and production had none, which closed the starter league and silenced 013's warning. Idempotent: a bot already present is skipped.
scripts.//db:seed-league-bots: The twenty-four opponents above Bronze. Every starter bot is Bronze (runes x 125 tops out at 2375; Silver's floor is 2500), so Silver through Diamond had NO authored defenders, candidates() fell below MIN_POOL and widened, and a player past Bronze met the same two accounts forever. Pass --dry-run first: it prints what would be created and the population per league before and after, and writes nothing.

//dependencies: @vercel/analytics is INSTALLED AND NOT YET IMPORTED, deliberately. Web Analytics counts page views reported by a browser script and nothing this app returns is a page, so `track()` from its /server entry point is the only thing it can ever do here — expect no API page views in the dashboard, ever. The events worth sending are the ones that happen with no browser attached: the Paddle webhook (013) and the replay-cleanup cron (016 registers it). Neither exists. When the first one lands it goes behind an interface in src/analytics.ts, the way @vercel/blob went behind src/replays/storage.ts, so that a route handler never imports the vendor directly and no player identifier can be passed as an event property.
//devDependencies: @hono/node-server is local dev only — Vercel supplies its own server and imports the default export of src/index.ts, so it never ships. pnpm rejects `//` keys INSIDE a dependency block, which is why this note is out here.
